architecture.approach: Add one shared locale layer in @riaya/shared (supported locales, Accept-Language negotiation, an error-code catalogue and Intl formatters). The server filter negotiates the request language and localizes the message while keeping the stable code; the backoffice sends Accept-Language from i18n.language and formats dates, numbers and currency with the active locale and the clinic timezone exposed by the membership view. No dependency and no schema change.

components.name: i18n
components.description: Shared module with SUPPORTED_LOCALES, negotiateLocale(header) and ERROR_MESSAGES for en/ar/fr.

components.name: format
components.description: Shared Intl formatters for date, time, number and currency with locale and clinic timezone, falling back to UTC.

components.name: HttpExceptionFilter
components.description: Negotiates Accept-Language and returns the localized message for the stable code, preserving details and requestId.

components.name: TenancyService
components.description: Adds clinicTimezone to the membership view.

components.name: api
components.description: Sends Accept-Language from i18n.language and falls back to a localized generic message.

components.name: OverviewPage
components.description: Uses the shared date formatter with the clinic timezone.

components.name: StaffDirectoryPage
components.description: Uses the shared date formatter with the clinic timezone.

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: Replaces its local Intl helpers with the shared formatters.

dataModel.flowDescription: No persistence change. Clinic.timezone already exists; the memberships response gains clinicTimezone. Stored timestamps stay UTC and are converted only at display time.

securityConsiderations.description: Localized error messages must not leak stack traces, ORM errors or internal identifiers (CON-507); an unknown exception keeps the generic message, and the response shape is unchanged.

dependencies.name: @riaya/shared
dependencies.notes: Already consumed by both apps; the locale and format modules are added inside it.

dependencies.name: i18next
dependencies.notes: Already installed; the active language is read at request time.

dependencies.name: react-i18next
dependencies.notes: Already installed; supplies the active language to the client.

dependencies.name: Intl
dependencies.notes: Built into the runtime; no package.

risks.description: The server catalogue and the client catalogues drift.
risks.mitigation: Both derive from @riaya/shared, and the locale-parity guard covers the client catalogues.

risks.description: A localized message hides a code clients rely on.
risks.mitigation: code is stable and never localized.
Intl with timeZone, UTC storage, and a DST-date test.

risks.description: Validation details remain English strings from class-validator.
risks.mitigation: The summary is localized, details are structured, and constraint keys can be mapped later.
